scope: four original tiny given-HZ cases, same algorithm CPU/GPU compatibility; not a performance or real-model confirmation
physical_roster: case order above; CPU then GPU on even case positions, GPU then CPU on odd positions; one call per arm/case, no repeats
physical_gate: requires a separate execution freeze binding passing controls and source bytes; busy gate records NOT_ADMITTED and does not consume a kernel request; no automatic retry loop
stop_rule: Stop batch after resource refusal, unresolved cleanup/release, numerical/identity error or timeout; retain completed prefix and pending roster. No substitution, added budget, changed dtype or rerunning a failed physical call.
differential: check each candidate exactly against original HZ; report CPU/GPU bound differences, do not require bitwise candidate equality or tune to it
